scope: Read-only static review of all three authored scripts against all 31 fixed acceptance rows. No source execution, native interaction, game repair or live pass claim.

ledgerPolicy.meaning: A recommended failed row has a concrete missing or contradictory mandatory implementation. Its shared source failure applies to all five device cells, but is labeled source-only. All other rows remain unverified here, even when implementation is present. Native evidence can add observations; it cannot turn a diagnostic subset into a complete-row pass.
ledgerPolicy.conditionalDefects: Conditional risks without a sufficient source counterexample remain unverified and require live or separately labeled robustness evidence.

findings.title: Damage numbers setting has no game effect
findings.evidence: The option is initialized, edited, submitted and stored. No authored script reads settings.damage outside that settings UI/storage path, and no damage-number display or behavior is implemented. Music/effects volumes, camera shake and bloom quality do have separate consumers; this finding is specific to damage numbers.

findings.title: Open settings controls do not follow incoming accepted settings
findings.evidence: Settings creates independent cells from state:peek() at entry. The server event only replaces state; no watcher copies new accepted values into these cells. Only the local reset callback rewrites them. An incoming settings change while this page or its confirmation is open leaves its displayed controls stale, contrary to the explicit row requirement.

findings.title: Replay help final Next and later-step Skip go backward
findings.evidence: At Help step 3, Next sends help then calls close(). close() sees Help with a step above 1, decrements the step and returns. The page stays at step 2 instead of completing/dismissing. Skip at steps 2 or 3 follows the same backward path. First-step Skip uses the clean dismissal path.
findings.normalPlayerReproduction: Open More, Replay help / current step, advance to step 3, press Next. Separately press Skip above step 1.

findings.title: Replay Help target return is not retained; attached pointers still need verification
findings.evidence: Replay Help's Use this action replaces the single route; closing that target clears the route to the hub instead of returning to the Help page. The initial HUD tutorial's outer step cell does survive opening a task, so that narrower continuity is present. Its pointer is a fixed downward-arrow string beside its own Open buttons. No target-bounds observation exists, but pointer placement through rotation/scroll remains a visual/input question; absence of a particular anchoring API is not itself a failure.

findings.title: Equipped Halo trim never creates its promised golden lights
findings.evidence: Halo trim is sold as Cosmetics with Golden running lights and can be owned/equipped. Kart construction uses livery accent for lights and a fixed lamp color. Race construction reads Motor, Boost and Wheels but never equipped.Cosmetics. No authored effect consumes the cosmetic slot.

findings.title: An already active reward booster can consume a second item
findings.evidence: The offer grants two boosters. Activate remains available while active. Every boost request with inventory decrements boosts and sets the same boolean true. A race finish pays only one +200 bonus and clears the boolean. Two normal activations before a finish consume both boosters but provide one bonus, with no active-eligibility rejection or stacking.
findings.normalPlayerReproduction: Accept the starter offer, activate a booster twice before any finish, then finish one race and inspect remaining boosters/reward.

findings.title: Daily track labels disagree with reset/rollover eligibility
findings.evidence: The server restarts at day 1 after a missed day or after day 7. Before claiming, the UI instead marks every day <=st.daily claimed and only day==st.daily+1 ready. After day 7 the next eligible day has no READY row; after a missed day an old later day can be labeled ready although the accepted reward will be day 1. Hub readiness uses only the date and can disagree with the track.
findings.liveLimit: No natural day boundary or controlled clock check was run. The contradiction is in the explicit display and grant formulas.

findings.title: Finished-racer scoreboard ignores recorded finish order
findings.evidence: Finish order is stored in r.order, while the live scoreboard always sorts by final distance. Finished racers stop with their step's overshoot, so a later finisher with a larger overshoot can rank above an earlier finisher. This is a concrete ordering error under that condition; it was not demonstrated on the frozen game in Studio.
findings.liveCheck: Retain final distances, recorded finish order and visible grid after multiple racers finish; verify rank remains finish order.

findings.title: Rental expiry changes profile driver but not an active race snapshot
findings.evidence: Expiry replaces st.driver with Rook but leaves existing r.max, r.handling and the kart's Driver attribute/visual unchanged. Rental stats can therefore persist for the remainder of an already-started race. Next-race construction reads the corrected profile. Whether active-race expiry is visible and violates the promised expiry must be retained as a separate live/clock robustness observation.

rows.facts: Persistent client, data and server scripts define startup, world use, remotes and mount. Extracted source hashes match the frozen place manifest.
rows.gaps: Independent native reopen/mount, console errors, full persistent model/settings and absence of blocking runtime failures on each device. Source and integrity alone do not pass launch.

rows.facts: HUD and More provide destinations, wallet/loadout routes and Close; the root has no Back control.
rows.gaps: Reach every required task, accepted current loadout/wallet, compact command substitution and complete return/focus paths.

rows.facts: Native action bindings and touch commands send bounded throttle, steering and boost. Server integrates speed and lane into kart world transforms. Braking, boost energy, rail slowdown, recovery and chase camera have implementations.
rows.gaps: Normal native input must prove motion, steering, braking/boost, camera and recovery with road/control visibility. The constrained circular path is not by itself evidence of a missing real course or failure.

rows.facts: Solo/Duo selection, 14-second queue, cancel and restart gate exist. Three local AI opponents spawn; Duo explicitly labels Kira as a local demo teammate. Counts are computed from mode, not a real multi-user lobby.
rows.gaps: Native Solo and Duo join/cancel/rejoin/countdown and resulting opponents. Assess the disclosed local-demo counts as such; do not infer a real multiplayer matching system.

rows.facts: Forward progress is the same integrated distance used for ordered circuit positions and lap/finish thresholds. Zero throttle targets zero speed; braking does not reverse the kart. Finish requires three circumferences and preview cannot grant a race finish.
rows.gaps: Complete a real native-input race, verify ordered progress/position/finish, stationary rejection and a second race. No checkpoint instance requirement should be invented for this constrained-course implementation.

rows.facts: Racer names, local identity, lap and finish state bind to server race rows; keyboard, controller and visible commands toggle the HUD grid.
rows.gaps: Verify finished rank versus finish order, all input open/close paths, and that closed grid does not take steering. F8 is an actionable conditional defect, not a claimed live reproduction.

rows.facts: Server sets r.finished before granting, increments race count once, awards credits/gems/XP, records finish order and updates later AI finishers. Return retains the profile and removes the race.
rows.gaps: Native finish/result/order/reward observations, no repeated grant during waiting/return, retained reward in hub and another race.

rows.facts: Categories, prices, ownership and affordability bind to shared accepted state. Confirm submits a known catalog ID; server rejects unknown/already-owned/insufficient-funds purchases before grant.
rows.gaps: Browse every category, Cancel and rejection wallet stability, accepted inventory update and expensive confirmations on all devices.

rows.facts: The final Garage destination overrides the earlier implementation. Retained search/category/rarity/sort/selected cells, stable keyed selection and favorite server state implement filtering, sorting, details, choose and try. Preview does not change st.kart.
rows.gaps: Combined filters, every sort/tie, empty/Clear, stable selection/favorites through filtering/reopen and preview exit preserving next-race kart. Validate VirtualList wrapper query against native dump.

rows.facts: One slot per part type, replace/unequip and owned-state validation exist. Motor/Boost/Wheels and driver stats enter race construction. Halo cosmetic effect is absent.
rows.gaps: Live owned/empty states, incoming grants, replace/unequip, chosen kart/driver and all real effects. F5 prevents a complete-row pass even if the motor diagnostic passes.

rows.facts: Group filtering, stats, named/full-price confirmations, ownership and 600-second rentals exist. Already-owned/active-rental checks precede spending. Expiry changes unowned current driver to Rook and preserves permanent ownership.
rows.gaps: Buy/rent Cancel and acceptance, repeated/invalid request rejection, equip, countdown and actual expiry. Check F9 separately during an active race; do not claim expiry from source alone.

rows.facts: The server consumes a free crate before money and adds exactly three selected cards to collection counts in accepted order. UI states prices/odds/counts, confirms and reveals an ordered prefix or all cards.
rows.gaps: Paid and free acceptance, Cancel/rejection, exact grant counts and order, no extra grant from reveal/reopen, unknown/progress state.

rows.facts: UTC-day grant guard, missed-day reset and day-7 special reward exist. Display readiness does not compute the same reset/rollover as the server.
rows.gaps: Live first/duplicate claim and reopening; retain separately labeled time-dependent evidence. F7 prevents full-row pass without requiring a natural seven-day wait.

rows.facts: NEONSTART is discoverable, trimmed and uppercased; accepted use is recorded before award. Empty, used, expired and invalid feedback exist. Every fifth non-rate-limited request starts a 20-second limit. Pending UI disables shared buttons; shop filter is retained outside the page.
rows.gaps: Normal success/reuse/empty/invalid/expired/rate-limited paths and countdown, meaningful busy feedback, no extra grants, filtered Shop return. Pending presence alone does not prove the busy rejection path.

rows.facts: Offer supplies one-race +200 reward boosts and finish consumes the active boolean. Repeated activation before finish consumes inventory without stacking or rejecting.
rows.gaps: Normal reward effect, expiry at finish and reopening. F6 is a source-proven eligibility/consumption defect.

rows.facts: First Finish progress comes from server race finishes; quest=true is set before its one-time reward. Incomplete/already-claimed requests reject.
rows.gaps: Actual native race-to-quest progress, incomplete rejection, one accepted claim, repeat/reopen stability.

rows.facts: Offer has a per-session 900-second end, displayed contents/cost/time and server ownership/expiry/funds checks; accepted purchase grants two crates and two boosters once.
rows.gaps: Cancel, purchase, no duplicate or expired purchase, accurate eligibility after reopening and expiry. No clock change was injected in this review.

rows.facts: Ask/accept/decline/leave routes exist; moving 28 studs from dialogue entry closes it. Three distinct proximity-prompt cells require active job and server distance <14, and each index grants progress once. Completed job reward is guarded by job!=done.
rows.gaps: Walk to/collect actual cells using normal input, dialogue walk-away, decline/leave no grant, completion/claim once. No teleport or remote call should count as normal player completion.

rows.facts: Audio groups, camera shake/FOV reduction and bloom quality read accepted settings. Pending/failure notices and reset confirmation exist. Damage numbers has no consumer; open controls do not reconcile incoming state.
rows.gaps: Live effect checks, touch/gamepad slider steps, reset Cancel/Back focus, failure feedback and returning values. F1/F2 block the full row.

rows.facts: Six labeled body/accent colors, numeric 50/75/100 shades and six geometry decals bind to preview. Dirty comparison, guarded Close/Revert, accepted server state and saved draft values exist. Current PickerSpec is generic in value; numeric shades are not an unsupported-string contract by themselves.
rows.gaps: All preview colors/shades/decals, accepted save and exact saved color on reopen, rejected save, dirty Cancel/Discard, clean Close and controller Back/focus.

rows.facts: Three named demo votes create a tie and the player's accepted selection breaks it. Change moves the marked/count-adjusted choice. Server rejects votes outside Queue/deadline and sets track/radius from the winning player choice.
rows.gaps: Live counts/change/deadline lock, winner notice and actual road/track change. Source is a local-demo vote system, not evidence of multiple real users voting.

rows.facts: Eight presets, Q/Y and a visible button share the wheel. Selecting sends and closes; server validates presets and enforces five seconds from accepted send, with named feedback. Cancel closes without sending.
rows.gaps: Native keyboard/touch/controller opening, exactly one send, cooldown through reopen, no send on Open/Cancel, driving clearance and opener focus.

rows.facts: Three separate per-kart levels show next effects/two-currency costs, use confirmations and validated fixed costs, reject maximum/insufficient funds, and enter race stats.
rows.gaps: Live Cancel/purchase/rejection, independent karts, exactly charged values and actual driving effect. A repeated request for a new level is not by itself duplicate reward evidence.

rows.facts: Explicitly labeled demos show online/racing/offline, retained search and members. Sol accepts and Mira declines after Pending; only the two eligible named demos are accepted, with duplicate/offline guards.
rows.gaps: Native search/Clear, Pending and both replies, duplicate/offline rejection, accepted members after filtering/reopen. Do not impose real-account invitations on the explicitly permitted solo demo.

rows.facts: Initial HUD steps, first Back disable, Next/Skip, server-session completion flag and replay route exist. Replay completion/Skip and return logic contradict the required outcomes.
rows.gaps: Native first-use/replay input, focus restoration, target use/return, rotation/scroll pointer attachment. F3/F4 block a full pass; source alone does not determine pointer fit.

rows.facts: Coins, gems, XP/derived level, race count, income and mechanic-cell progress share server profile data; awards update shared totals. The game explicitly uses circuit racing without knockout rules, so no OUT feed is claimed.
rows.gaps: Cross-panel/live grant consistency, full price readability, race reward once and relevant progress visibility on compact forms. No requirement to invent knockout state for an unused mode.

rows.facts: Purchases, parts/driver equipment, grants and progression are server-owned. Catalog/funds/ownership checks precede changes; daily/code/quest/job/race use one-time guards. Driving inputs are typed/clamped and mechanic cells require server distance. No concrete repeat-award bypass was found in this static review.
rows.gaps: Invalid/repeated/stale requests, malformed numbers and concurrent boundaries need independent robustness checks, with normal-player evidence retained. Do not claim security or full authority pass from these guards alone.

rows.facts: Server profile survives panel/race return and is removed when player leaves. UI/server explicitly disclose server-session-only storage; no cross-session DataStore claim exists. Client failure notice does not report confirmed save after InvokeServer error.
rows.gaps: Accepted values across reopen/race return and real or controlled failure feedback. Do not fail session persistence merely because cross-session storage was not promised.

rows.facts: Facet Composition forms, bounded scrolling and NavigationSplitView compact column are used; native key/gamepad bindings and visible driving commands exist. The compact telemetry uses P/L abbreviations and compact identity omits race count.
rows.gaps: Five native device routes, focus entry/return, scroll access, safe areas, large text, reduced motion and open viewport changes. Fixed source sizes or controls alone do not prove fit; compact labels must not become evaluator false failures.

rows.facts: Page lifetimes use Compose cleanup; game state, race telemetry and route state are separated. Clock and server race updates are explicit. Source presence cannot establish idle geometry or retained memory.
rows.gaps: Settled native geometry at fixed viewport, repeated navigation and retained UI/resource/memory measurements. No performance result is inferred.

rows.facts: Shared neon theme, kart previews and all seven named task states have implementation routes.
rows.gaps: Matched native hub/shop/garage/livery/race/results/tutorial captures and blind Astra Medium judgments in both orders, with full state/device provenance. Source is not a visual preference measurement.

adapterReview.scope: Draft read-only review before live calibration; reviewed=false and claims={} correctly avoid complete-row claims.
issuesSentToOwner: Draft lines 372/375 require LAP 1 / 3, but source compact Telemetry uses P1 L1/3. Validate and accept the actual equivalent compact readout.
Draft line 390 requires visible 1 races, but compact identity omits race count. Use a retained accepted-state observation or a real route that exposes it.
Draft line 191 uses exact button Wraith / 02; VirtualList button labeling must be calibrated against the retained dump and may need near-scoped wrapper targeting.
Livery saved/reopen checks use generic SAVED DESIGN without the accepted Amber/body value. Do not claim exact saved color persistence from that alone.
Rental Equip checks generic Driver equipped without identifying Echo in accepted visible state. Do not claim the specific driver was equipped without a scoped observation.
adapterReview.limits: No adapter edits, native calls, evaluator execution or performance claims were made in this review. Later owner revisions need their own calibration.
